rationale: The frozen answer 10,605 derives from a 2017 estimate cited in the 'Bora Bora' Wikipedia article (e2, s3/s4). The 'Bora-Bora (commune)' Wikipedia article (e1, s1/s2) reports a more recent 2022 census population of 10,758, updated as of the page's 2024-05-21 revision. Population is an inherently temporal fact that changes with each census/estimate cycle, so the 2017-based figure is superseded by the 2022 census figure. No genuine source conflict exists between e1 and e2; e2 is simply an outdated/unsynced page relative to e1's newer census data.
